headline: Pakistan Increases Wheat Import Ceiling by 150 Percent to 2.5 Million Tonnes
summary: Pakistan's Economic Coordination Committee approved increasing the wheat import ceiling by 150% to 2.5 million tonnes to curb continuously rising domestic prices of wheat and flour.
why: Pakistan is a major consumer of wheat in South Asia, where food staple prices significantly impact inflation and consumer purchasing power.

impacts.name: Wheat
impacts.why: The government raised the import ceiling to 2.5 million tonnes to stabilize domestic wheat prices.
